title: When the soul needs company strong enough to cool it
issueStatement: Alone, the mind keeps recycling itself. In the wrong company, it becomes louder, sharper, and more forgetful of what it actually needs.
centralInsight: Gurbani treats sangat as placement, not generic belonging. Right company changes the inner climate: truth becomes speakable, Naam feels near, and the mind stops feeding only itself.
practicalReflection: Not every circle nourishes. Some company strengthens noise, ego, and drift; holy company makes return easier than self-invention. What changes here is not only mood, but the inner rule you let govern the next moment.
actionPrompt: Before the next hard moment, when the mind starts wandering alone, move toward the company that steadies it.
